{"rewritten_prompt": "A wide horizontal Chinese fantasy romance character profile poster fills the frame, designed as an antique manuscript-style heroine sheet with warm beige parchment texture, sepia ink-brown typography, soft gold borders, and cinematic period-romance photography. The overall composition is divided into a large portrait area on the left, a text-heavy dossier column in the center-left, a grid of scene thumbnails on the upper-right, two close-up detail cards in the middle-lower right, and four small mood photographs along the bottom edge. The background uses muted cream, tan, gray-brown, and desaturated gold tones, with blurred wooden window frames at far left, blossoming branches across the upper-left area, translucent curtains, garden scenery outside the windows, and a refined ancient Chinese interior atmosphere.

On the left half, a large realistic portrait of an East Asian young woman occupies most of the vertical space. She appears in her early twenties, with a slim build, pale fair skin, an oval face, delicate eyebrows, large soft brown eyes, long lashes, subtle eyeliner, warm peach blush, and muted rose-red lips. Her expression is calm, wistful, and introspective, looking upward and toward the right rather than directly at the viewer. She has very long black hair styled in an elaborate historical updo with loose strands framing her face. Ornate silver hairpins, dangling chains, floral ornaments, pearl-like drops, blue beads, and gold filigree decorations spread across the crown of her head. She wears layered white and ivory hanfu-style robes with translucent sleeves, embroidered floral patterns, pale gold detailing, and soft draped fabric textures. Small earrings and delicate jewelry are visible near her ears and neckline. The portrait is shot in a close-up to half-body framing from a slightly low or eye-level angle, with shallow depth of field and cinematic lighting that highlights the face and hair accessories while the garden background remains softly blurred.

Along the far left edge, the main vertical title appears in dark ink-brown calligraphic Chinese characters: "沈清晏". It is written vertically from top to bottom in large bold brush-style type, with a red square seal stamp beneath it containing very small stylized seal-script characters that are too tiny and ornate to read clearly. To the right of this main name column, smaller vertical role labels read "古偶" and "言情女主设定", arranged vertically from top to bottom in dark brown. A thin vertical divider line separates these labels from a pale gold vertical subtitle reading "· 角色卡 ·", also written vertically. This left title area sits over the blurred window-and-blossom background and functions like an elegant period-romance character card header.

Near the top center-left, a section heading in dark brown reads "角色小传 / BIOGRAPHY". The English word “BIOGRAPHY” is spaced out in uppercase Latin letters after a slash, matching the antique editorial design. Full body text as follows: "沈清晏，江南名门沈家嫡女"
"自幼聪慧灵秀，琴棋书画样样精通"
"性情清冷寡言，不喜与人争锋"
“清晏如月，静照人心。”

Below the biography, a framed profile card occupies the central-right portion of the left column. It is a rounded rectangle with a thin gold outline and subtle paper texture inside. At the top-left of this card, a circular beige-gold emblem contains a dark botanical sprout icon in an outline style. To its right, large bold black characters state the character name: "沈清晏". A short gold decorative dash-like line appears below the name area. Under the name, smaller profile labels read "籍贯：江南吴郡", "身份：沈家嫡女", and "血统：清贵世家". Farther down within the same card, a label reads "喜好：诗词、古琴、梅花、清净之地", followed by another label reading "厌恶：虚伪之人、权谋争斗、嘈杂喧闹". Below those, a label reads "信条：清晏如月，静照人心。", presented like a personal motto. The lower part of the card contains four circular outline icons in muted brown-gold: a flame-like symbol suggesting inner warmth or passion, a lotus flower icon suggesting purity and grace, and two leaf-like symbols suggesting natural elegance and restraint; these icons are evenly spaced horizontally.

Below the framed profile card, another section begins with the dark-brown heading "角色性格 / CHARACTER". Full body text as follows: "外柔内刚，心思细腻，情感克制而深沉。
因自幼被寄予厚望，背负家族重任，
习惯独处与沉默，不轻易敞开心扉。
对爱执念极深，一旦认定便愿以一生相守。
厌恶背叛与背叛，却仍心怀善念，不愿以恶制恶。"

On the upper-right half, a heading reads "角色经历 / EXPERIENCE" in dark brown serif-like Chinese type. Beneath it is a row of six small rounded-rectangle cinematic thumbnails with thin pale borders and narrow gutters. The first thumbnail shows an elegant palace corridor or arched interior in warm light, with traditional columns and soft reflections, suggesting the heroine’s refined noble upbringing. The second thumbnail shows the heroine seated indoors at a wooden table writing or studying on papers; she wears pale robes, leans forward quietly, and has her hair pinned up with ornaments. The third thumbnail shows a misty blue-gray garden or night scene with blossoming branches and water reflections, creating a cold, poetic atmosphere. The fourth thumbnail shows the heroine from behind or in side profile beneath moonlight or cool night lighting, with dark hair and flowing sleeves silhouetted against a dim courtyard or architectural background. The fifth thumbnail shows an emotional close confrontation between two period-dressed people facing each other; one woman’s pale profile is partly visible on the left while another figure leans close from the right, conveying tension or intimacy. The sixth thumbnail shows a warm ceremonial interior where the heroine appears to be preparing for a wedding or formal ritual, surrounded by red and gold decorative elements, candles or lantern-like glows, and blurred attendants or objects.

In the middle-right lower area, two larger rectangular close-up photographs sit side by side inside a bordered detail section. The left close-up focuses on the heroine’s face in three-quarter profile, cropped tightly around her nose, lips, cheek, eye, ear, hair ornaments, and dangling earrings. Her expression is solemn and inward-looking, with soft skin highlights and fine strands of black hair crossing her face. The right close-up focuses on her shoulder, robe embroidery, layered ivory fabric, gold threadwork, necklace chains, earring details, and the back/side of her elaborate updo. Both images use shallow focus, warm cinematic grading, and ornate historical costume texture.

Along the bottom-right strip, four smaller horizontal photographs appear in a row with thin borders. The first shows the heroine alone indoors or near a window, leaning forward over a table or paper surface in pale robes, her posture subdued and contemplative. The second shows a rainy courtyard or exterior scene with wet stone reflections, dark architecture, falling rain streaks, and cool blue-gray lighting. The third shows her seated by candlelight at night, reading or writing with papers on the table; warm flame light contrasts with the dark background and emphasizes a quiet study-room mood. The fourth shows her from behind near water, looking toward mountains or a distant landscape under soft evening or dawn light, conveying solitude and longing.

The poster uses multiple rectangular image panels separated by narrow cream-white dividers and thin gold outlines. Many of the panel borders are rounded rectangles with double-line effects, giving the layout an antique album, dossier, or luxury character-card appearance. Decorative elements include pale ink-wash texture behind the biography text, faint paper stains, soft shadows under cards, small floral ornament motifs near headings, circular icon buttons in muted brown-gold, and seal-stamp accents. The visual style combines photorealistic period-costume portraiture with Chinese xianxia or guogu (ancient romance) character-sheet design. The lighting is warm on indoor scenes, cool moonlit or rainy blue-gray in the more dramatic thumbnails, and softly diffused through the garden background. The color palette is restrained: ivory robes, black hair, muted gold accessories, dark brown typography, parchment beige backgrounds, gray-blue shadows, and occasional red-gold wedding accents.", "wh_ratio": "16:9"}
